title: Science Fair, Mysore
teaser: A Science Fair was jointly organized by the Indian Academy of Sciences, the Indian Young Scientists' Association, and the Mysore Science Foundation over two days at Teresian High School and Chaitra School, Mysore.
homepageMatter: A Science Fair was jointly organized by the Indian Academy of Sciences, the Indian Young Scientists' Association, and the Mysore Science Foundation over two days at Teresian High School (28 June) and Chaitra School (29 June), with a combined attendance of about 300 high school students.
